semiconductor_relevance: High — Litho Tech Japan specializes in lithography equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Litho Tech Japan manufactures evaluation and process equipment specifically for semiconductor lithography. Their offerings include automated and manual systems for resist coating, developing, and baking, catering to both research and production environments.
capabilities: Manual resist coating systems (Litho Spin Cup series)
Robotic transport systems for wafer processing

regional_presence.Japan: Litho Tech Japan is based in Japan, focusing on the domestic semiconductor equipment market.
